text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

VEGOIL SALES - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries bought 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower oil and 10,000 tonnes of degummed soybean oil for delivery in the second half of July. The sunflower oil was bought for $564.9 per tonne C+F and soybean oil for $559 per tonne C+F. - El Salvador bought 2,908.5 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow cottonseed oil in bulk and 1,500 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under PL-480 export program. El Salvador also purchased 2,374 tonnes of tallow, all for July 20-August 5 shipment.
CORN SALE - Philippine poultry and hog producers bought 23,000 tonnes of Chinese yellow corn for July arrival, industry officials and traders said.

CORN AND BARLEY SALE - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Tuesday said it accepted a tender from Amiga International for 25,000 tonnes of barley for $141.90 per tonne C&F and a tender from Toepfer for 18,000 tonnes of corn at 133.95 per tonne C&F. Scheduled shipment was for July.

CORN AND SOY TENDER - Malaysia's Soon Soon Oilmills Sdn Bhd is expected to tender on Wednesday for a combined cargo of corn and soybeans totalling 55,000 tonnes, traders said. The consignment is for October shipment and November arrival.

WHEAT TENDER - Algeria has tendered to buy 150,000 tonnes of optional origin soft wheat for July and August shipment. On Monday European traders reported Algeria was seeking 150,000 tonnes of bread-making wheat.
- The CCC said it was tendering on June 17 for up to 5,080 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Kenya. Shipment was slated for July 1-25.

WHEAT TENDERS (cont.) - The CCC said it would tender on June 19 for up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Armenia. The wheat was slated for June 30-July 15 shipment. The tender was in combination with another for 1,500 to 2,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL-480 program, Title One. Shipment on the second tender was also June 30-July 15 with offers also due on June 19.

- Guyana was tendering on Thursday for 2,300 tonnes of spring wheat, 1,000 tonnes of soft red winter and 3,000 tonnes of hard red winter under the PL-480 program, agents for the buyer said. Shipment was slated for July 4-26.

PALM OIL TENDER - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries said oon Tuesday it was seeking 25,000 tonnes of Malaysian and/or Indonesian palm stearin and palm oil for delivery in August. Moharram Ghanem, head of the sales sector, told Reuters the deadline for bids was 0900 GMT on June 25. He said he wanted the oils in the following lots: -- 10,000 tonnes of palm stearin and 15,000 tonnes of palm oil.
MARKET TALK - Grains traders in China and Hong Kong said on Tuesday their Chinese customers were not tempted by Monday's drop in soybean futures and were waiting for lower prices.
